archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / INDUSTRIAL SAAS TACTICAL MINIMALISM
app_type: Enterprise EPC SaaS App (Data-Dense Dashboard & Operations Hub)

numeric_tables.usage: Use for all numerical values, monetary amounts in USD, hour totals, tolerance percentages, batch IDs, and meters.

layout_architecture.structure: Fixed Left Sidebar (width 256px on desktop, collapsible on mobile) + Fixed Top Navigation Bar + Dynamic Content Canvas with Sticky Page Headers.

elements: Global Active Project Switcher Dropdown (e.g. 'PRJ-2026-088: Metro Line Expansion (Phase 2)')
Role Switcher (Field Foreman, Project Manager, Cost Controller, Admin)
ERP Connection Status Pill (Green dot: Oracle Fusion PPM Live)

screen_1_dashboard.name: Budget vs Actual Executive Dashboard
components: KPI Cards: Total Project Budget ($14.2M), Total Actual Spent ($9.85M), Overall Cost Variance (-$340K / Over), Pending Approvals ($124.5K)
Budget vs Actual Cost Breakdown Table with progress bars (Status: OK green <=80%, Warning amber 80-100%, Stopped red >100%)
Cost Breakdown by Category Chart (Labor, Heavy Equipment, Raw Material)
ERP Sync Status Widget with last sync timestamp & manual trigger button

screen_2_crew_planning.name: Crew & Resource Planning Grid
components: Filters: Project, Date Range Picker, Shift selector (Day/Night/Overtime), Foreman Team
Matrix Grid: Resources x Hour Types (Regular Hours, Overtime OT1.5, OT2.0, Idle Time, Harsh Weather, Maintenance Downtime)
Material Allocation Sub-grid: Planned Quantity, Unit of Measure, Batch Assignment
Action Bar: 'Save Draft' button, 'Publish Plan to Foremen' button, 'Auto-fill from Baseline' action

screen_3_labor_timesheet.name: Labor Entry & Timesheet Capture
components: Foreman Quick-Check Matrix: Auto-filled from daily crew plan
Resource Row: Avatar, Craft/Trade, Present Checkbox, Planned Hours vs Actual Hours input, vs-Plan % Diff, Tolerance Status Badge (OK / Warning / Exception)
Manual Bulk Entry Drawer for ad-hoc craft hires
Supervisor Sign-off canvas / Digital acknowledgement button

screen_4_equipment_entry.name: Equipment Usage & Downtime Capture
components: Equipment Fleet Table: Asset ID (e.g., EX-402 Caterpillar Excavator), Category, Operator Name, Start/End Hour Meter reading, Total Operating Hours
Downtime & Reason Code Selector: Maintenance, Weather Delay, Fueling, Operator Idle, Site Obstruction
Special Approval Flag toggle for non-budgeted equipment usage
Fuel Consumption & Maintenance log fields

screen_5_material_entry.name: Material Consumption & Issue Log
components: Material Issue Form & Grid: Item Code (e.g., REBAR-GR60-25MM), Description, Unit of Measure, Quantity Issued, Quantity Wasted, Quantity Returned to Stock
Storage Location / Warehouse Yard dropdown selector
Batch / Heat Number tracking input
Unit Cost & Total Cost Calculation widget

screen_6_approvals.name: Multi-Level Approvals Queue
components: Filter Tabs: All (5), Pending Level 1 Foreman (2), Pending Level 2 PM (2), Special Exception (1)
Approval Cards / Rows: Batch Summary, Creator, Cost Impact, Approval Step Progress (Step 1 of 2 vs Special Approval required)
Action Controls: Inline Approve & Post to Oracle PPM, Reject with Required Reason Modal, Request Re-entry

screen_7_rate_cards.name: Master Rate Cards & Cost Rules
components: Labor Rate Card Table: Trade Category (Journeyman Electrician, Heavy Crane Operator), Regular Base Rate ($/hr), OT Multipliers, Shift Differential
Equipment Hourly Rate Table: Asset Model, Internal Rate ($/hr), Rental Rate ($/hr), Fuel Surcharge Rate
Material Standard Cost Registry
Currency & Index Adjustment Rule Configurator (USD default)

screen_8_setup_config.name: System Configuration & Tolerance Engine
components: Tolerance Threshold Rules: Soft Warning % (e.g., +5%), Hard Stop Threshold % (e.g., +15%)
Auto-Approval Scope Rules: Auto-approve timesheets within 2% of plan
Notification Triggers: Email / In-App alerts for budget overrun
Reason Codes Management Table

screen_9_reports.name: Variance Analysis & Cost Export
components: Cost Variance Summary Matrix (Planned vs Actual vs Variance $ and %)
Daily Labor & Equipment Utilization Heatmap
Export Bar: CSV, Excel, PDF Export buttons
Custom Filter Builder by Cost Code & WBS Level

screen_10_erp_integration.name: Oracle Fusion PPM & ERP Connector
components: Connection Health Card: Oracle Fusion PPM REST API Endpoint, OAuth 2.0 Token Status, Last Master Data Sync
Master Data Sync Actions: Sync Projects, Sync WBS/Cost Codes, Sync Employee Roster, Sync Equipment Assets
Push Batch Audit Log Table: Batch ID, Timestamp, Records Pushed, Oracle Status Code (HTTP 200 OK / Error), Error Retry trigger button

screen_11_users_roles.name: User Access & Role Management
components: User Table: Avatar, Name, Email, Role (Field Foreman, Project Manager, Cost Controller, System Admin), Assigned Projects, Status
Role Permissions Matrix (Read/Write/Approve per module)
Invite User Modal & Clerk Sign-in Integration indicator

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns, modals, tabs, check boxes, status badges) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds has at least 4.5:1 ratio. Numeric data in tables must use high contrast text (#F9FAFB on #111827).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS with custom slate/zinc dark mode utility classes and subtle borders (border-gray-800 or border-white/10).
Implement Sonner toast notifications (via sonner package) for actions like Save Draft, Publish Plan, Approve, Reject, and ERP Sync.
Use Lucide-React icons extensively throughout navigation and action buttons.
Ensure high density tables have hover highlights (hover:bg-slate-800/50), explicit column alignments (left for text, right for numeric values), and mono font for numeric figures.
Include sample data preloaded for realistic EPC projects (e.g. Metro Line Expansion, Refinery Unit 4 Upgrade, Offshore Platform Build).
Every interactive element MUST have a unique data-testid attribute.
